candidate.definition_en: Having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs, or capable of operating independently without external control.
candidate.explanation_ar: مستقل.. بيحكم نفسه بنفسه أو بيشتغل لوحده من غير تحكم خارجي.

senses.definition_en: Having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs; independent.
examples: The country is divided into several autonomous regions.

senses.definition_en: Able to operate, function, or make decisions without direct human control.
senses.definition_ar: ذاتي التشغيل أو القيادة دون تدخل بشري مباشر.
examples: The development of autonomous weapons systems raises ethical questions.
The country is divided into several autonomous regions.
The development of autonomous weapons systems raises ethical questions.
candidate.mnemonic: 'Auto' يعني 'تلقائي' أو 'ذاتي'.. 'Autonomous' يعني شغال مع نفسه باستقلالية.
